research_notes: Blocked after official biography, contemporaneous professional profile, first speech and employer annual report: recover clinical employment dates, historical Chiltern control, individual FTE and whether university/network roles are one joint appointment.

Aggregate hospital workforce FTE does not identify Haines's own hours. The annual report is stronger on May2019 executive end date than the ANMF profile's general statement about deciding to run; neither establishes leave dates.

Hospital-based nursing and midwifery training is not counted as paid work without a dated employment record. Study, fellowships, adjunct affiliations and directorships must not be summed with concurrent clinical years.
Public professional-profile access returned 429; no bypass attempted. Three-decade career descriptions do not establish thirty full-time public-sector years.

Uppsala research-associateFebruary2013 differs from official adjunct role2014–2019; retained as reconciliation gap rather than erasing facts.

Employer historical report resolves Chiltern private community control; contemporaneous nonprofit status still needs constitution/annual report. First speech supplies age26 and three-year matron duration, not exact dates or FT. Do not back-calculate calendar boundaries from birthday or narrative sequence.

Follow-up2026-10-03: primary University annual reports2015–2018 identify Haines in a single staff row as Senior Lecturer – Director Rural Health Academic Network, resolving the network's University of Melbourne institutional context and showing that the academic/network roles must not be independently summed. A2012 peer-reviewed author affiliation records the earlier Research Co-ordinator title. Exact title-transition dates, contract fraction, leave and overlap with hospital work remain unknown.
